tools.name: search_vault
tools.description: Search the user's Granite document vault and return ranked matches (title, type, dates, a short snippet, linked entities). Use this to FIND documents; then call get_document for their full field values. Returns metadata only.

query.description: Search query, natural-language or keyword, e.g. "2024 W-2" or "home insurance policy".

mode.description: Search mode. Default "hybrid" (recommended). "keyword" = exact term/number match; "semantic" = meaning-based.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List documents in the vault, oldest-cursor first, as metadata. Cursor-paginated: the response carries `next_cursor` and `has_more` — pass `cursor` to get the next page. Prefer search_vault when you know what you want; use this to browse.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Fetch one document by id with its full structured fields — title, type, dates, extracted field values, linked entities and collections. Set include_full_text to also return the raw OCR/body text (larger payload; only when you need verbatim contents).

id.description: The document id (uuid) from search_vault or list_documents.

include_full_text.description: When true, include the full OCR/body text. Default false to keep payloads small.

tools.name: ask_vault
tools.description: Ask a natural-language question across the whole vault and get a synthesized answer with citations to source documents (e.g. "When does my passport expire?"). Requires the `vault:ask` token scope. Use get_document to read any cited document in full.

question.description: The question to answer from the vault's contents.
